messages:
ana-partnerships: Heads-up — EdgeHub wants to stop hourly appliance exports and switch to per-minute (they mentioned per-second events). They asked for a migration window + reconciliation playbook.

sam-engineering: Quick q — will they send a new schema or just change the unit on the existing payload?

ana-partnerships: New field proposed: `usage_seconds`. Sample payload they sent:

```json
{\n  "device_id": "edgehub-77",\n  "ts": "2026-03-20T09:02:00Z",\n  "usage_seconds": 45,\n  "sku": "redwood.edge.medium"\n}
```

sam-engineering: Ingest plan proposal: accept both schemas for a 30-day coexistence window, add feature-flagged parser that converts seconds -> minute buckets server-side, and offer an optional backfill (90 days) on request. Rough estimate: 2 dev days + 1 infra day. Need a canary rollout (limit to 10 devices).

jess-devex: We'll stand up a partner sandbox with replay and golden-files. Add docs for idempotency behavior — require `idempotency_key`. If partner doesn't provide one, we'll synthesize and tag it so recon can detect.

katie-sre: Ops: add per-partner ingestion rate limiter, monitoring dashboard (p95 ingest latency, dup-rate, synthetic-idempotency rate). Throttle backfills to avoid downstream spikes.

marc-legal: Legal note — changing billing granularity can impact contracts and revenue recognition. We need an amendment specifying effective date, proration rules, and notice to end-customers. Preserve audit trail for any invoice adjustments.

partners-bot: ACTION_CREATED: onboarding-ticket #PRT-1999 (assigned to sam-engineering). Checklist: schema-support, sandbox, backfill-plan, billing-signoff, legal-amendment.

ana-partnerships: Proposed migration window from 2026-04-06 (start) to 2026-04-20 (stop hourly). Is that feasible?

sam-engineering: Tight but doable if we parallelize. We'll lock canary list and feature flag and produce a deploy plan today.

jess-devex: ETA for sandbox + docs: EOD tomorrow. I'll include mapping CSV and sample replay commands.

jess-devex: sample replay curl for partner testing:

```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/partners/ingest \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d @edgehub_sample.json
```

katie-sre: ops follow-up: require `idempotency_key` in schema. If absent we'll synthesize and log a `synth_idempotency=true` field for reconciliation.

marc-legal: Ping with final effective date and we will draft the amendment.

ana-partnerships: Action items summarized: (1) sam: scope + estimate + deploy plan, (2) jess: sandbox/golden-files/docs, (3) marc: amendment draft once date locked, (4) katie: monitoring + rate limits. I'll request last-30-days sample data from EdgeHub. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
